system.description:
Queen of the Summer Court. Warmth that can become burning in an instant.

  • Dark Gift (1st): Warm light emanates from you when you cast: no shadows form within 10ft. For 1 Patron Favour, when a creature within 30ft fails a save, every die of that effect against it is treated as its highest result.
  • Patron's Mark (4th): Passive: fey creatures, animals, and plants react positively to your presence — animals never attack you first, and fey creatures treat you as a known and respected figure until you give them reason not to.
  • Patron Feature (8th): For 1 Patron Favour, impose Summer's Blessing or Summer's Wrath on one creature within 60ft.
  • Blessing: the target regains 2d8 HP plus your Warlock level (no save).
  • Wrath: Fortitude save against your Class Save DC or it is Weakened and Slowed for the encounter.

Allegiance: Chaotic Good, the patron's alignment. Lore: Tiandra (Titania) in the World of Arneyan wiki.
